text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Countin' on you, Kris S!
Harmonizing the "Voice of Destiny" with my own coaching to guide Epiphaneia's growth—
"For that reason, I asked Symboli Kris S for her cooperation and requested a tandem training session. It was to recreate the conditions where our voices successfully aligned."
choice_data_list: Listen closely to my voice.
Listen carefully to my voice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll keep my ears open!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!
choice_data_list: Alright, hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Understood, let's go right now!
UOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
choice_data_list: Huh!? Hold back—!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
I gave it everything I had!
choice_data_list: Yeah, she was really running with all her might...
Yeah, she was really running... with everything she had...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Failure.
A failure, it is.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Ahaha, sorry about that! I really wanted to go, and the voice of destiny told me to let it fly!"
choice_data_list: Then it can't be helped, huh...
Then it can't be helped, huh...

text_block_list.text:
It likely wasn't something that could be easily replicated.
...Perhaps at this juncture, we ought to reorganize the fundamentals from scratch once more.
choice_data_list: (Regarding the voice of destiny—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny is the voice of destiny!
It's a voice only I can hear! That's all there is to it!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, tell me a little more in detail.
Yeah, could you tell me a little more in detail?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, I can only really say what I said before! In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny is
the greatest voice that pushes me forward!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: When I think, "This is it!" and the voice of destiny affirms it with a "Yes!", something awesome is definitely waiting!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Was that the answer you were hoping for?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right...
Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.text:
Whether the voice of destiny is purely psychological
or truly something mysterious...
what matters is the order in which the voice is heard.

Only after Epiphaneia decides something is "good"
does the voice of destiny push her forward.
Her own will always comes first.
choice_data_list: (Maybe the key is getting Epi to understand?)

text_block_list.text:
In other words—all we need is for them to believe
that following your guidance will lead to
even better things than before.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm fine! Thanks for your help.
Yeah, no problem! Thanks for your help.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
Well, I'm off then!
choice_data_list: Ah... Wait, they're already gone.
Yeah... Wait, they're already gone.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Huh? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A treat for you!
I just won a free drink from the vending machine♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You had a pretty grim look on your face earlier!
Get some sugar in you to clear your head!
choice_data_list: Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like my timing was spot on!
The voice of destiny told me to go for it too!
choice_data_list: (She really is an honest, friendly girl...)
(She really is an honest, friendly girl, isn't she?)

text_block_list.text: It wasn't that she distrusted my coaching; rather, because she believed in herself so strongly, she simply prioritized other people's opinions less.

"Then as expected, through actual coaching,
I just need to present her with better options."
choice_data_list: (This is where I show what I'm made of!)
(This is where I show what I'm made of!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
The menu just got way more lavish!
choice_data_list: I tried making the explanation a bit more detailed.
I tried making the explanation a bit more detailed.

text_block_list.text:
To build trust in the training regimen,
I added data and refined it to make "why this menu works" crystal clear.
choice_data_list: Doesn't it feel like doing it this way will make you stronger?
Doesn't it feel like doing it this way will make you stronger?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrrrrrmmm...
Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The numbers you're putting up are amazing! And I get the point of it.
But... it just doesn't hit me in the gut!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't you demonstrate it for me in person!
It'll be way easier to understand that way!
The voice of destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? Isn't that person doing high knees...
Epi's Trainer?
choice_data_list: Huff...!! Huff...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. Is she acting as a role model?
...Though she seems a little too desperate for that—
choice_data_list: Uwoooooooh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a full sprint!?
...What!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer!
That was a great run!
choice_data_list: Th-Thank... y-you...

text_block_list.text:
To help Epiphaneia fully understand, I had her complete a routine
adapted for humans, then timed her all-out sprint. And then—
choice_data_list: ...! Look, your time is improving!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible!
Congratulations!!
choice_data_list: (Ah, they finally understand—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, my method is way more incredible! I'll make you fast, so just follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!!!
choice_data_list: (......I won't give up!)

text_block_list.text:
However, trying to convince her through pure logic
won't reach someone who relies on her intuition.
choice_data_list: (Unless she truly thinks it's "good"—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
âLook, what a great view!
You can see sooooo far away... I'm so moved!

Looking back, whenever she felt something was "good,"
beautiful scenery and enjoyable experiences always awaited.
If only I could provide that for her—
choice_data_list: (Will that make her believe me more...?)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
What's the matter? Are you worn out!?
choice_data_list: Epi, about our next day off...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Good morning! (She really came...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for inviting me!
I'm super happy to see you even on our day off!"
choice_data_list: (She really is such a straightforward girl...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So, what're we playing today!?
You're gonna give me a real thrill, right?
"Yes, I'm planning to spend the entire day giving her experiences she'll really enjoy."
choice_data_list: First, let's go shopping!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
So cute!! It's Cesario!!
choice_data_list: Kris S is over here with us too.
Kris S is on our side too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
She looks so sharp and cute!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Wait, these little ones don't have tags?
choice_data_list: I've already picked them up in advance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!?
Then what are you doing here!?
choice_data_list: Let's find custom outfits for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see!!
Sounds interesting, let's look for it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Look at this! Isn't it cute?!"
choice_data_list: Hmm, which one should we put it on?
Yeah, which one do you want to attach it to?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: To you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it really is cute!
choice_data_list: (W-why...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
You can see the whole town from here!
choice_data_list: Try looking through the telescope over there.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You can see pretty far from here—
...Hm? Wh-Whaaaat?!
What is with that electric bulletin board?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!!!!
It says, "Do your best, Epiphaneia"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Could it be that you're... the one!?
choice_data_list: The surprise was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What a surprise—! I'm so happy, thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! A picture!
Hehe, I gotta show this off to everyone!
choice_data_list: (...Hehe, that's a relief.)

text_block_list.text: Though it was for the sake of her training, seeing Epiphaneia look genuinely happy naturally brightens my own heart as well.
And so, I enjoyed the experience I had prepared for Epiphaneia right along with her...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Trainer!
Laughing together with you was truly the best!
choice_data_list: It's not over yet!
It's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh?

"Looking at my watch, I begin a countdown in my head.
The next moment—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh...!?
It's a fountain show!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

As Epiphaneia watches the show,
her eyes sparkle brilliantly—
choice_data_list: （……Maybe now it'll reach her heart.）

text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely guide her down the right path.
So please, believe in me..."
Just as I opened my mouth to say those words—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I love you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I became certain today!
You care about me this much
and make me so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You are the greatest trainer!
The voice of destiny says so, too!!
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's go home!!!!
choice_data_list: Huh? ...What!?

text_block_list.text:
Overcome with a mix of emotions,
I chased after Epiphaneia—
and found her on the track.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, Trainer!
My warm-up is all done!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Give me an order!
—An order that'll make me stronger!
choice_data_list: ...!! Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want to see where you will lead me!
So give me whatever guidance you think is best!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll believe that your power can make me even stronger!!
The voice of destiny says I should, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, share your vision!
I want to see it all!!
choice_data_list: Of course, I'll show you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then what should I do first?
choice_data_list: First of all... let's get changed!

text_block_list.text: And so, the voice of destiny began nudging Epiphaneia to follow my guidance instead.
...At times.
